sentences.text:
Respond
 Through: Mr. Shoaib Haider, App for the S

Coram:
 Hon'Ble Ms. Justice Neena Bansal Krishna
 Order

A Criminal Petition under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 has been filed on behalf of the Petitioner for quashing of FIR No.432/2021 under section 498A/406 IPC P.S.
Nabi Karim, Delhi.
2. The Respondent No.2 is not present.
3. It is submitted that the Respondent No.2/Complainant is not coming forth for Settlement.
4. Notice of the Petitioner be served upon the Respondent No.2 on taking steps by the Petitioner, to be served through ordinary post and electronic mode, returnable for the next date of hearing.

5. List on 27.03.2026.
NEENA BANSAL KRISHNA, J.
DECEMBER 22, 2025/VA
